response_property_constraints.description: Amadeus Property Code must be exactly 8 characters consisting of uppercase letters and digits (pattern ^[A-Z0-9]{8}$).
Brand or Merchant code must be exactly 2 uppercase letters (pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$).
Brand code must be exactly 2 uppercase letters (pattern ^[A-Z]{2}$).
The IATA city code associated to the hotel must be exactly 3 uppercase letters (pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$).
The type of the object should be 'hotel-offers'.
The 'available' property must be a boolean value.
Offer id must match pattern ^[A-Z0-9]*$ and have length between 2 and 100 characters.
check-in date must follow the YYYY-MM-DD format.
check-out date must follow the YYYY-MM-DD format.
Special Rate code must be exactly 3 characters matching pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$.
The data type of an offer must be 'hotel-offer'.
number of adult guests must be an integer between 1 and 9.
Room type code must match pattern ^[A-Z0-9*]{3}$.

boardType must be one of the enumerated values: ROOM_ONLY, BREAKFAST, HALF_BOARD, FULL_BOARD, ALL_INCLUSIVE, BUFFET_BREAKFAST, CARIBBEAN_BREAKFAST, CONTINENTAL_BREAKFAST, ENGLISH_BREAKFAST, FULL_BREAKFAST, DINNER_BED_AND_BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, FAMILY_PLAN, AS_BROCHURED, SELF_CATERING, BERMUDA, AMERICAN, FAMILY_AMERICAN, MODIFIED.
paymentType must be one of: GUARANTEE, DEPOSIT, PREPAY, HOLDTIME, guarantee, deposit, prepay, holdtime.
The rate type must match pattern [PNC] (public=P, negotiated=N, conditional=C).
Tax currency must be a three alpha (IATA) code, with length between 1 and 3 characters.

request_response_constraints.description: The hotelId of each returned hotel must be one of the values supplied in the request 'hotelIds' parameter.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Amadeus property codes on 8 chars. Mandatory parameter for a search by predefined list of hotels.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request specifies a 'checkOutDate', each returned offer's checkOutDate must equal that requested value.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Check-out date of the stay (hotel local date). Format YYYY-MM-DD. The lowest accepted value is checkInDate+1. If not present, it will default to checkInDate +1.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request specifies 'adults', each returned offer's guests.adults must equal that requested number of adults.
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: Number of adult guests (1-9) per room.

request_response_constraints.description: When the request specifies a 'currency', returned offer prices should use that currency (unless the hotel does not support it, in which case the local currency is returned).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description:
Use this parameter to request a specific currency. ISO currency code (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/currency_codes.htm).
If a hotel does not support the requested currency, the prices for the hotel will be returned in the local currency of the hotel.
